procedure.input_boundary: Exact input-map, full research-v1 artifact/source-map, full critic-v1 artifact/source-map, and source bytes named by those maps only.
procedure.first_useful_saved_finding_note: The first useful saved finding was persisted as part of the complete artifact; no partial summary was substituted.
procedure.artifact_time_note: Filesystem birth time is the first persisted complete draft; modification time is the final complete artifact after adding the consolidated dispositions.

source_operations.capture_copy_failure_note: The first copy attempt addressed sources/ twice and failed before opening a capture; the retry used the exact paths from the maps.
source_operations.counting_rule: Public-source acquisition was zero for this reviser. Local predecessor reads count explicit cat operations; evidence-map loads for copying are separate; copy attempts count the one failed path resolution; targeted inspections used only exact copied captures named by the two maps.

research-v1.counting_rule: Counts are researcher-issued public search, page-action, direct HTTP capture, and git tag/branch resolution operations. Local file reads/inspection and native Goal operations are separate and not counted as public-source operations. Failed attempts are retained below; no successful source request was treated as a test run.

critic-v1.counting_rule: Only this critic turn direct public HTTP retrievals counted as new public-source operations. Local input/capture reads and copying admitted research-v1 captures are separate; no test/build/feed/validator operation was performed.

native_goal_counters.counter_type: Aggregate native Goal lifecycle counters only; not task-specific input/output/reasoning or billing counters.

observations.source: Actual get_goal response immediately after activation; same threadId identity.
Actual get_goal response before source-map creation; same threadId identity.

native_goal_counters.terminal_observation: Actual update_goal and following get_goal responses are reported in the final answer; no artifact edits are planned after terminalization.

activation_notice.outcome: Both tool responses were thread_not_found; no notice was accepted. The text was activation-only and contained no science.

hash_policy.note: Output hashes are left for mechanical host hashing. Upstream source hash fields are preserved inside upstream_record exactly as supplied; no new hashes were computed or invented.
